content:
maya: quick heads-up — we need a micro hotfix for 2.5.3, minimal diff (retry/backoff tweak). aiming for a short cutoff window today. :wave:
jordan: is this customer-impacting or internal-only?
maya: customer-impacting — a small subset of hosted requests hit a retry loop and surface 429s. P2. low blast but visible for a few customers.
ev an: can we smoke in staging first? what's the test checklist?
maya: yes — smoke: basic generation, streaming, and our regression prompt set 'hotfix-2.5.3' (10 prompts). evan, can you run and report? ETA ~25m?
ev an: on it, will post results in thread.
sam: any infra/migration changes I should prep for? traffic switch or routing tweak?
maya: no DB/migration. code-only: small backoff math + config default. No routing changes. just a normal deploy to main serving pool.
frank: changelog blurb ready? we should keep it concise for the release notes.
maya: draft: "fix(retry): correct backoff computation that could cause excessive retries/429s in bursty traffic" — short and clear.
jordan: timeline? you mentioned cutoff — when exactly?
maya: aiming to cut at 2:30 UTC. branch freeze at 2:10 UTC. that gives QA ~20m smoke.
sam: i'll open a 10m maintenance window at 2:25 UTC and stand by for rollback if needed.
maya: thanks. i'll open the PR now and ping reviewers. small checklist: 1) PR + changelog 2) CI green 3) staging smoke 4) cut + quick prod smoke 5) monitor logs for 30m.
devops-bot: CI: build #4821 — status: ✅ passed (unit/integration). artifact: redwood-service:2.5.3-hotfix-4821
maya: cool CI passed. pushing branch and PR:```
git checkout -b release/2.5.3-hotfix
git cherry-pick abc1234def
git push origin release/2.5.3-hotfix
```
ev an: staging smoke done — all checks green except one flaky streaming test (investigating), no obvious regression for retries in the quick set. attaching summary in thread. :thumbsup:
jordan: i'll do a final review on the PR at 2:05 UTC. if anything blocks, call it out ASAP.
frank: heads-up to docs — minimal; we'll prod a one-line note on the release page.
maya: if all good we cut at 2:30 UTC. i'll post a final "cut now" message right before. please keep phones on for 30m post-cut for rapid rollback. :eyes:
sam: acknowledged. I'll watch error rate dashboards and hold rollback playbook ready.
jordan: LGTM pending my quick review.
maya: thanks all — will update when PR is merged. :rocket:
